title: operator_marks: one mark the person at the PC dropped during a clock-calibration session
description: One row per line of raw/operator_marks/marks.jsonl. A mark carries its own performance counter bracket, taken in the mark process at the moment the command ran, so it sits in the etw_qpc domain and needs no calibration to be placed next to kernel events. See docs/contracts/decoded-tables.md section 5.19.

at_utc.description: Verbatim: the mark's system time as the mark command wrote it.

qpc_mid.description: Derived: floor((qpc_before + qpc_after) / 2), the counter value the mark stands for.

half_width_100ns.description: Derived: ceil((bracket_ticks / 2 + 1 tick) * 10^7 / qpc_frequency_hz). The mark's position on the master clock is exact to this plus the time between the felt moment and the keypress, which nobody measures.

process_id.description: The mark process (never the game or any other process).
